description: Edit a finished video according to a review comment file (a `video_review` JSON the video editor writes under comments/ and the opening message names, carrying a top-level `taskType` and `source` metadata about the task that made the video). Start with skills/edit-video-by-comment.md: it validates the JSON and routes to the editing skill for the video's source task type. The video is edited where it was made, in the linked task directory named in the file access rules.

requirements.name: ffmpeg
requirements.purpose: Probing, frames and the render's audio mix (content-maxima tools)

requirements.name: python3
requirements.purpose: content-maxima tools/captions.py, tools/make-timings.py, tools/fetch-resource.py and the music bed

requirements.name: @aws-sdk/client-s3 + client-lambda
requirements.purpose: content-maxima tools/render/render.js and audit.js run their browser on AWS Lambda (CM_RENDER_LAMBDA / CM_RENDER_BUCKET)

requirements.name: @spira-lab/cli
requirements.purpose: Hosting the new render and model docs. Never used to submit, wait on or check a job

requirements.name: spira sign-in
requirements.purpose: The Spira CLI must be signed in as the operator to generate or upload anything

requirements.name: openai-whisper
requirements.purpose: Word timings, needed only when a comment changes what is said (content-maxima tools/make-timings.py)

stages.title: Read and validate the review JSON from comments/, route to the editing skill
Find the video, map every comment onto it, write the fix table
Generate what a comment needs, make the edits, pass the audit
Render, host and report each comment's outcome

outputs.description: A copy of the new render under results/
Hosted URL of the new render (spira assets upload)
One line per comment: #n timecode, fixed / partly / not fixed, what changed
